_comment: Pin for the Microsoft VC++ 2015-2022 x64 Redistributable bundled into the Windows installer. sha256 is deliberately unset: scripts/ci/fetch-vcredist.ps1 refuses to stage anything until a person has reviewed a download and run it once with -UpdatePin, then committed this file. Caveat: the aka.ms URL always serves Microsoft's NEWEST build, so the pin goes stale whenever Microsoft ships one; for a stable pin, host the reviewed file in a location we control and set url to it.
